learning_objective: 🎯 Master the art of solving mathematical puzzles using correct operation rules and understanding how numbers and brackets work together!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Just like words make up sentences in English, numbers and symbols (+, -, ×, ÷) make up expressions in Math! An expression tells a mathematical story without using an equal sign.
Brackets are like VIP passes in math. Whatever is inside the brackets gets solved first! They help us organize our calculations and avoid total confusion.

When you have a long expression with many symbols, you must follow a strict order of operations so everyone gets the exact same answer. Multiplication and division always beat addition and subtraction!

fun_activity.title: 🧩 The Bracket Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Use the numbers 2, 3, 4, and 5 exactly once with any math symbols and brackets to create an expression that equals 26!

quick_recap: ⭐ Expressions are math sentences built with numbers and operation signs.
⭐ Always solve the puzzle inside the brackets first before moving outside.
⭐ Order matters! Following the correct sequence prevents wrong calculations.
